content.rationale: Session state lives in three systems: Cavemem SQLite, LanceDB, and the canonical store. Only the canonical store is what the dashboard reads, so a restore note that is not recorded there is invisible to the person who would need it.
content.trade_offs: The git digests migrated into the canonical store carry agent_reported authority rather than git_verified, because migrate-legacy does not link them to real commits. They are honest about provenance but not cryptographically verified.
